text:
A distributed online marketplace that uses Java 21, Spring Boot, and MongoDB.

The project focuses on making a modular and scalable marketplace application that can be accessed using Hybrid communicaton layer:
	a JavaFX GUI interface using sockets
	REST API endpoints for external vendor integrations.
The system also includes:
	Client and server-side (Jakarta) validation for all requests
	a custom Jackson application level protocol for socket communication
	JWT authentication for controllers
	custom authentication for the socket connection
	AI-powered product enrichment using Spring AI.

The Mongo database was configured using containers with a mongo router routing to 2 shards (can be extended). The users are evenly distributed across both shards using a hashed shard key, items are sharded according to brand, as the marketplace has a search by brand feature, so it would only hit one shard, and transactions are sharded by the buyer ID, which ensures the account page which shows previous transactions only hits one shard. The project uses 3 modules configured using Gradle: client, server, and common; and using spring dependency management for identical dependency versions across multiple modules.
